_meta.adr: ADR-037 modular manifest fragment — never edit src/manifest.json. ADR-022: consumes OpenRegister's declarative `IS NULL` filter operator (zoeken-filteren spec, `<field>_isnull`) instead of a bespoke worklist service.
_meta.description: Missing-document worklist (routing-audit-2026-07-14.md item 2): two `type:"index"` pages filtering on `sourceDocumentUri: null` — the exact `filter: {"field": null}` idiom already used by the existing UnmatchedItems page (`src/manifest.json`, filter `{"resolutionStatus": null}`). `sourceDocumentUri` was added to both SupplierInvoice and Receipt by receipt-extraction-consume.json; no schema change needed here. Sorted oldest-invoice/receipt-date-first so the most aged gaps surface at the top of the list — no hard date cutoff is declared (OR's simple index-page `filter` does not support relative-date bindings; that is an aggregation-only capability), so "aged" is expressed as default sort order rather than a filtered threshold. No PHP: OpenRegister's REST layer already resolves the `_isnull` predicate against the register's search backend.

config.description: Supplier invoices with no attached source document (UBL/OCR/Peppol origin never resolved) — a declarative OpenRegister `sourceDocumentUri IS NULL` filter (routing-audit-2026-07-14.md item 2), oldest invoice date first so the longest-outstanding gaps surface at the top. Not a bespoke worklist service.
Expense receipts with no attached source photo/scan — the same declarative `sourceDocumentUri IS NULL` filter as the supplier-invoice worklist, oldest receipt date first.
